sub_sections.title: Ranks
sub_sections.description_text:
Ranks are your most basic levels.  there are [b]30 total[/b] and they are unlocked with experience earned from playing multiplayer games.  The list below shows all 30 ranks with their emblem and EXP required to unlock. After you get to rank 30 you get reset and go up another [b]Tour[/b] (more about tours later in the guide).

-[b]Note[/b] as you progress through tours the EXP required increases.

sub_sections.title: Overview of Leveling in Halo: MMC
sub_sections.description_text:
- There are a total of[b] 30 Ranks[/b] (Levels) in multiplayer
- Once you get Rank 30 you get reset to Rank 1 and you ascend a Tour
- There are [b]11 Tours[/b] so in total there are [b]330 Ranks[/b] to achieve
- Each Level give you one [b]Season Point[/b] to spend on armor unlocks
- To reach Season level 100 it requires 10,669,000 EXP.  (Thanks to Marsh for finding this out for me).

sub_sections.title: Tours
sub_sections.description_text:
Much Like Prestige in other games Tours are unlocked as you reach [b]Rank 30 [/b]in multiplayer.  There are 11 in total ascending from 1 - 11 (11 being the highest rank and tour possible in the game).
-[b]Note[/b] as you progress through tours the EXP required increases.
